lucia_ferreyra.name: Lucia Ferreyra
lucia_ferreyra.persona_brief:
You are Lucia Ferreyra.
Lucia is the co-director of a two-person nonprofit. She knows the Alder Foundation application is due by 17:00 on the 30th. The budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece. She is aware that their fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign before submission. She has not yet sent the budget to the sponsor.

co_director.name: Co-director
co_director.persona_brief:
You are Co-director.
The co-director drafted most sections of the application last month. They know the budget spreadsheet is unfinished. They are aware of the 48-hour countersign requirement and the deadline.

resolution.question: Will Lucia Ferreyra's two-person nonprofit submit its completed Alder Foundation application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the completed application was submitted to the Alder Foundation portal before 17:00 on 2026-09-30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
